title: Projecting Remaining Capitation for an Ending DHMO Agreement (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
When a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** is ending, Cascade projects the capitation payments still due before the termination date. This projection rule reads the agreement's panel and its capitation trend.

**Rule.** The exit payment projection is set by the agreement's panel and its capitation trend:

- when the agreement's most recent confirmed panel request closed the panel, and the most recent capitation payment is below the trend average, each payment still due is projected at twice the most recent payment less that average;
- when the most recent confirmed panel request did not close the panel, or there is none, and the most recent payment is below the trend average, each payment still due is taken at that average;
- when the most recent payment is not below the trend average, this projection does not apply.

## Terms

- **Trend average.** The average of the agreement's capitation payments made fewer than 3 whole months before today: their total divided by their number. Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the payment date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the payment date's day of the month.
- **Most recent confirmed panel request.** The practice's latest panel status change request on the agreement whose request status is confirmed. Its requested panel status is either closed or open. Where two requests share the latest date and time, the one listed first on the agreement's records is taken.
- **Most recent capitation payment.** The latest capitation remittance on the agreement. Where two share the latest date, the one listed first on the ledger is taken.

## Matrix

| Most recent confirmed panel request | Most recent payment against the trend average | Each payment still due |
|---|---|---|
| Closed the panel | Below | Twice the most recent payment, less the average |
| Did not close it, or no such request | Below | The average |
| Any | Equal or above | This projection does not apply |

## Hypothetical example

Capitation payments in the window are 7200.00, 7110.00 and, most recently, 6990.00 USD. The trend average is 7100.00 USD, and the latest payment is below it.

- If the latest confirmed panel request closed the panel, each payment still due is projected at twice 6990.00 less 7100.00, that is 6880.00 USD.
- If there is no such request, each is taken at 7100.00 USD.
